title: 1936 Prairie's tower stands square above the roof
items: In 1904, the lookout at the top of the Thompson house's tower at 1936 Prairie Avenue is now a full square above the roof, as the old photograph shows it, instead of a thin slab against the front wall. Its south side now has its arched window, and its balcony and cornice run all the way round.
The photograph shows only the front and south sides. The windows on the other two sides are our reconstruction.
